subject: Renewal negotiation: assurance scope adjustment + seat uplift (SOC 2 evidence cadence)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: BrightCart Security <security@brightcart.com>; Ava Bennett <ava.bennett@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal negotiation: assurance scope adjustment + seat uplift (SOC 2 evidence cadence)

Hi Ava / BrightCart security team,

Thanks again for the heads-up about your upcoming renewal (12/15). We’re excited about the seat uplift you signaled in the renewal call — happy to partner on an evidence cadence that minimizes lift for your team while covering the SOC 2 re-attestation items you need.

Two quick asks so we can scope the evidence collection:
1) Can you confirm whether BrightCart is requesting an expanded assurance scope (specifically: inclusion of customer-managed logging ingestion and cross-account S3 access in the audit scope), or whether you prefer to limit the attestation to the existing service boundary?
2) For retention: what minimum log retention window do you require for audit logs (90 days / 180 days / 12 months)? We can support S3 export with signed access tokens if 12 months is required, but there are cost and contract implications we should discuss.

Proposed plan from our side if you want to keep effort low:
- Narrow scope to core production services + current integrations (no customer-managed ingestion) — reduces evidence volume.
- We’ll prepare a focused evidence manifest (I’ve attached a draft) grouping items by control (CC6, CC7, logging, access reviews).
- Offer: for the seat uplift (requested +40 seats, Dedicated capacity), Redwood can provide a one-time renewal credit and commit to a 12-month log export retention at the Dedicated tier if BrightCart agrees to the focused scope.

I’ve CC’d Marissa and Jonas to align on commercial and technical approvals. If it helps, I can propose two alternate timelines for evidence handoff: a compressed 2-week bundle for rapid renewal, or a 6-week staged upload.

Best,
Marcus
Director, Customer Security & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx (manifest of items we’ll produce), log_samples_s3_manifest.txt (S3 export example)
From: Ava Bennett <ava.bennett@brightcart.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCart Security <security@brightcart.com>; BrightCart Procurement <procure@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation: assurance scope adjustment + seat uplift (SOC 2 evidence cadence)

Marcus,

Appreciate the clear framing. A few clarifying items from our side:
- BrightCart prefers that the re-attestation exclude customer-managed ingestion and cross-account access for now — we want the audit to cover the managed Redwood boundary only.
- Retention: we need 12 months of audit logs for compliance with our internal policy. Is Redwood able to commit to exporting 12 months of storage for the Dedicated tier?
- Evidence cadence: compressed 2-week bundle works if Redwood will accept staged uploads (i.e., control families sent in 3 batches across the 2 weeks). We don’t want daily churn.

Also copying Procurement — we’ll need a small amendment in the MSA to reflect the retention commitment and the seat uplift pricing. Please put any proposed language in the evidence manifest or share a short redline.

Thanks,
Ava Bennett
Security Program Manager
BrightCart Inc.

Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation: assurance scope adjustment + seat uplift (SOC 2 evidence cadence)

Thanks, Ava — that’s helpful. Confirming Redwood’s proposed commitments and next steps:

1) Scope: agree to limit re-attestation to Redwood’s managed service boundary (exclude customer-managed ingestion and cross-account S3). We’ll document the boundary in the manifest.

2) Retention: Redwood can commit to making 12 months of audit logs available for your reviewers for the Dedicated tier. Operational detail: logs will be exported to a customer-specific S3 bucket we control with time-limited access tokens; BrightCart may request an S3 replication manifest for long-term archival. This will require a small addendum to the MSA to cover storage+egress costs — Marissa, Jonas: see commercial ask below.

3) Evidence cadence: we’ll do staged uploads across a 2-week window in 3 batches (controls set A, B, C). We’ll provide a single manifest (attached) and presigned S3 manifests for each batch. BrightCart team: please confirm the reviewers/IDs we should grant access to.

Commercial proposal (for Procurement):
- Seat uplift: +40 Dedicated seats (annual) — tiered discount at 12 months commit.
- One-time renewal credit: 10% of the uplifted seats for the first billing cycle in exchange for the compressed evidence cadence.
- MSA addendum: retention + storage fee pass-through estimated at $1,200/mo for the additional 12-month retention bucket. Jonas, can Legal/Finance draft a short addendum?

If this looks OK I’ll schedule an evidence-handoff kickoff (30 min) for Wed 11/25 or Thu 11/26 and share the S3 access instructions.

Best,
Marcus

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx, log_samples_s3_manifest.txt

All — quick commercial follow-up from Redwood Sales. We can accept Marcus’s technical commitments as drafted. A few notes on the commercial mechanics: 

- Deal: BRIGHT-2026-11-RNW-17 — I’ll push the renewal amendment with the addendum language. Proposed redline summary (short): Redwood will provide 12-month exported audit logs for dedicated customers subject to an addendum covering storage/egress; seat uplift pricing updated with a one-time credit equal to 10% of the uplifted seats’ first invoice.
- Timeline: to hit the 12/15 renewal we need the signed amendment + evidence kickoff by 11/26 COB. If Procurement can sign the addendum early next week we’ll hold pricing.
- Action items for BrightCart: please provide a list of reviewers (name + email) for S3 access and confirm procurement point-of-contact so I can attach the redline.

Jonas / Vivek — please flag if any legal/infra constraints prevent the S3 presigned manifest approach.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
